issue.title: Command-chip preview palettes lack --color-blue and --text-on-accent, so copy chips render without the blue copy well

task_type_fields.impact: Preview-only: misleading review screenshots for command chips and the Make or edit chip card; no runtime effect.
task_type_fields.repro:
Since bob-chips 0.15.0 (bob-plugins 9b3c339), every copy-chip color mixes from `--bob-copy-chip-ink: var(--bob-copy-chip-hue, var(--color-blue))`, and the well's glyph uses `--text-on-accent`. The light and dark palettes in `scripts/preview-command-chips.template.html` define neither variable. `scripts/preview-command-chips-author.cjs` borrows those palettes by regex, so both previews render copy chips with an invalid ink: no blue well, no tinted body, and no border. The COPY CHIP header icon in the author preview also renders as a bare glyph with no well.

Repro: `CHROMIUM_PATH=<chromium> node scripts/preview-command-chips-author.cjs --out /tmp/a && node scripts/preview-command-chips.cjs --out /tmp/c`. Then look at the COPY CHIP card (icon and "Preview: SSH" chip) in /tmp/a/command-chips-author-light.png, and at the copy chips on the "Mixed copy and run chips" lines in /tmp/c/command-chips-light.png. scripts/preview-copy-chips.cjs, which uses Obsidian's default palette, shows the real look. Root cause and fix: add Obsidian's defaults (light `--color-blue:#086ddd`, dark `#027aff`, `--text-on-accent:#ffffff`) to both palettes, then rerun both previews. Real Obsidian is unaffected; the e2e on athena shows the blue well.

issue.creation_reason: The command-chip and author-card previews borrow a palette that predates the blue copy well, so their copy chips and COPY CHIP icon misrepresent the shipped look to anyone reviewing those captures.

payload.description: The command chips epic added the author preview that borrows the palette missing the copy-well variables
